integration_issues.flow: Tab navigation - Uploads and Profile screens
integration_issues.issue: Uploads and Profile screens remain as overlays after navigating away, blocking all interactions with Jobs screen including job card clicks
integration_issues.details: After navigating to Uploads or Profile tab and returning to Jobs tab, the previous screen remains visible as an overlay with higher z-index, intercepting all pointer events. This is an Expo Router + React Native Web screen stacking issue. Job cards become unclickable after visiting Uploads or Profile tabs.

react_native_issues.component: Expo Router Tabs - Screen stacking on React Native Web
react_native_issues.issue: Tabs component does not properly unmount or hide screens when navigating away, causing z-index overlay blocking
react_native_issues.details: This is a known issue with expo-router Tabs on React Native Web. Screens persist in DOM with higher z-index after navigation. Workarounds include: switching to NativeTabs (unstable), using portals for overlays, or absolute positioning hacks. See: https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/25958

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Expo Router tab overlay issue - consider switching from <Tabs> to <NativeTabs> from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' (Expo SDK 50+)
Alternative: Implement portal-based overlay system at root layout level to avoid tab z-index conflicts
Alternative: Add lazy unmounting with screenOptions or use absolute positioning workaround
Test fix: Clear Metro cache with 'npx expo start --clear' after any layout changes
Verify fix works on both web preview and native Expo Go app
